svg.title: Thirumaran S L — AI/ML developer
svg.desc: Thirumaran S L fixes bugs in the ML frameworks he uses. An exploded ML stack shows merged pull requests pinned to their layers: vLLM in serving, TensorFlow in graph capture, Brevitas in export and quantization, PyTorch in operators, above the silicon layer.
